findings.original: health insurer · insurance provider · contact the insurer
findings.issue: insurance provider是近义短语而非以目标词insurer为核心的搭配，削弱目标词训练。
findings.proposed: health insurer · major insurer · contact the insurer

findings.original: road cyclist · cyclist helmet · group of cyclists
findings.issue: cyclist helmet不如cyclist's helmet或cycling helmet自然；后者未出现目标词。
findings.proposed: road cyclist · experienced cyclist · group of cyclists

findings.original: soft pillow · pillowcase · rest your head on a pillow
findings.issue: pillowcase是由pillow派生的独立词，而非目标pillow本身的搭配。
findings.proposed: soft pillow · pillow cover · rest your head on a pillow

findings.original: horse-racing jockey · professional jockey · jockey rides a horse
findings.issue: jockey rides a horse更像句子片段而不是惯用搭配，建议改成目标词自然动作搭配。
findings.proposed: professional jockey · champion jockey · a jockey rides in a race

findings.original: indicative of · indicative sign · indicative evidence
findings.issue: indicative of在教学搭配中没有补足宾语，且indicative sign存在含义重复。
findings.proposed: be indicative of a trend · indicative results · indicative price

findings.original: etch指在硬质表面刻出图案；paint是将颜料涂在表面。
findings.issue: etch可以通过化学腐蚀形成图案，而非总是机械雕刻；现有对比过度缩小词义。
findings.proposed: etch指通过刻划或腐蚀在表面形成图案；paint通常是涂上颜料。
